insiders._note: Insiders buying (SEC Form 4). Uses watchlist.edgar_user_agent; empty = no EDGAR calls, the panel says so. Every key is described in markets/README.md.
insiders._transaction_codes: Form 4 table I codes kept. P = open-market or private purchase with own money. A (grant), M (option exercise), S (sale) etc. are left out on purpose.
insiders._roles: Which reporting-owner flags count: officer, director. 10% owners are not included unless also one of these.
insiders._us_exchanges: TradingView exchange prefixes treated as US-listed (only these are looked up on EDGAR).
insiders._ticker_replace: TradingView to SEC ticker spelling, e.g. BRK.B -> BRK-B.
insiders._rate_limit: SEC fair-access policy allows at most 10 requests per second; 0.15 s apart stays under it. max_requests_per_run bounds one refresh.

words.heading: Insiders buying
words.no_user_agent: SEC EDGAR is off: set watchlist.edgar_user_agent (your name and email) in markets/config.json.
words.disabled: Insider filings are switched off in markets config.
words.errors: {n} EDGAR request(s) failed on the last check; showing what is cached.
words.budget: request budget for this run used up
words.empty: No officer or director open-market purchases over the threshold in the cached filings.
words.weekly_line: - {n} open-market purchase(s) by officers or directors: {items}.
words.weekly_none: - No officer or director open-market purchases over the threshold this week.
words.weekly_off: - SEC EDGAR is off (no edgar_user_agent in markets config).

funds._note: Who's trading what: big funds' 13F-HR moves quarter on quarter (markets/funds.py). Uses watchlist.edgar_user_agent and, for any request key not set here, the insiders block's (one SEC rate limit). Every key is described in markets/README.md. Information only.
funds._list: Funds followed: name (shown), manager, SEC CIK of the 13F filer, optional note. Checked on EDGAR 15 Nov 2026: every CIK files 13F-HR. Add or remove funds in markets/config.json (a list there replaces this one).

list.name: Scion Asset Management
list.note: No 13F-HR since the one filed 3 Nov 2025 (Scion deregistered); that filing is what is shown.

funds._info_table: The information table is the filing's .xml that is not the primary document (nor in skip_documents) and has info_row_tag rows.
funds._value_multiplier: 13F value is whole US dollars since 2023 (thousands before); value x this = dollars.
funds._thresholds: An add or trim is listed when the share count moved by at least move_min_pct AND the money moved (shares moved x this quarter's price) by at least move_min_usd. New positions and exits at or over new_exit_min_usd.
funds._refresh_hours: The snapshot refreshes funds at most this often; `python -m markets funds` always does.
funds._names: Issuer name -> ticker: both names normalised (abbreviations spelt out, drop words removed) and matched to sec.gov company_tickers.json titles; one match = that ticker, several (share classes) or none = the issuer name is shown. cusip_tickers (CUSIP -> ticker) wins over the name match.

words.heading: Who's trading what
words.small_print: 13F filings come up to 45 days after the quarter they cover, so these are last quarter's positions, filed late by design: US-listed long positions and listed options only (no shorts, no trade dates). Information only, not financial advice.
words.no_user_agent: SEC EDGAR is off: set watchlist.edgar_user_agent (your name and email) in .review/markets.local.json or DENISSE_EDGAR_USER_AGENT.
words.disabled: Fund 13F filings are switched off in markets config.
words.never: No 13F filings fetched yet: run python -m markets funds.
words.errors: {n} EDGAR request(s) failed on the last check; showing what is cached.
words.budget: request budget for this run used up
words._move: One template per kind of move. {money} = money moved (new: the position, exit: last quarter's position, add/trim: shares moved x this quarter's price); {pct} = share count change %; {share} = % of the portfolio after; {put_call} = the put_call word or nothing.
words.no_previous: Only one filing cached: nothing to compare with yet.
words.weekly_heading: Big investors: new filings this week
words.weekly_none: - No 13F-HR filed this week by the funds followed.
words.weekly_off: - SEC EDGAR is off (no edgar_user_agent in markets config).

_local_config: local_config_path: a git-ignored file (relative to the repo) deep-merged over this config at load, because the repo is public: put watchlist.edgar_user_agent there. The environment variable named by user_agent_env, when set, wins over both. See markets/README.md.
